title: Resignation from the House of Representatives
notes: The day's House section as govinfo serves it, pages H8727 to H8730 (one read, on 2026-11-14 at 01:28:59 UTC, the fourth request of the day loop). The resignation, laid before the House, is on its first page: the Member's letter to the Speaker, dated November 1, 2019, giving notice of the resignation effective November 3, 2019. The letter's own granule was not asked: the granule govinfo's link service gives for page H8727 (https://www.govinfo.gov/link/crec/165/H/8727, seen 2026-11-14) is the Speaker pro tempore's announcement of the whole number of the House.
